items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the economic development law, in relation to the establishment of a New York seafood marketing task force
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5385

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the economic development law, in
relation to the establishment of a New York seafood marketing task
force

 PURPOSE :

To establish a New York State Seafood Marketing Task Force Act of
2017.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. Amends the Economic Development Law by adding a new Article
23 establishing a New York Seafood Marketing Task Force.

Section 2. Severability Clause

Section 3. Effective Date

 JUSTIFICATION :

There are currently insufficient resources and information necessary
to support New York's local fishermen and aquaculturists and related
small businesses to ensure the best possible economic and
environmental outcomes for the creation of more locally produced
sustainable food systems in the State of New York. This legislation
would establish the "New York Seafood Marketing Task Force Act of
2017." The Task Force would consist of eighteen non-compensated
members that will support and work collaboratively with the New York
fishing community to promote the marketing sustainability of New York
seafood.

The New York Seafood Marketing Task Force shall provide a report of
its findings to the Governor and the State Legislature by December 31,
2018. Thereafter, the Task Force shall report the progress made in
achieving goals and objective co the Governor and Legislature no later
than December 31st of each year.

Similar programs that are currently in place in Massachusetts and
Rhode Island have been. a successful tool in efforts that promote jobs
and stimulate economic activity. Enactment of this measure will
benefit the local seafood industry while providing enhanced
opportunities that will allow New York to remain competitive with
these states.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2017: New Legislation

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

A.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5385A

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the economic development law, in relation to the
establishment of a New York seafood marketing task force

 PURPOSE :

To establish a New York State Seafood Marketing Task Force Act of
2017.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1. Amends the Economic Development Law by adding a new Article
23 establishing a New York Seafood Marketing Task Force.

Section 2. Effective Date

 JUSTIFICATION :

New York's seafood and aquaculture industries contribute significantly
to the State's economic vitality. These industries are a rich and
vibrant part of New York's history, however, these industries have
undergone significant changes in recent years and will be faced with
many challenges in the years ahead. This legislation recognizes the
contributions of these industries and seeks to provide insight an
understanding to the role of these industries and their continued
value and growth.

This legislation would establish the "New York Seafood Marketing Task
Force Act of 2017." The Task Force would consist of nineteen
non-compensated members that will support and work collaboratively
with the New York fishing community to promote the marketing and
sustainability of New York seafood.

The New York Seafood Marketing Task Force shall provide a report of
its findings to the Governor and the State Legislature by December 31,
2018. Thereafter, the Task Force shall report the progress made in
achieving goals and objectives to the Governor and Legislature no
later than December 31st of each year.

Similar programs that are currently in place in Massachusetts and
Rhode Island have been a successful tool in efforts that promote jobs
and stimulate economic activity. Enactment of this measure will
benefit the local seafood industry while providing enhanced
opportunities that will allow New York to remain competitive with
these states.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2017: New Legislation

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
